skill_name: Compare and contrast nuclear and solar energy.
workflow: Nuclear and solar energy are both sources of clean, renewable energy and can help to meet our energy needs while minimizing environmental impacts. Nuclear energy requires a large capital investment to build and maintain a nuclear power plant, but produces more energy at a lower cost than solar. Solar energy is more affordable, but may require a large upfront investment in infrastructure and panels. Nuclear energy is generally thought to be more reliable than solar in terms of consistent electric
